_comment: The version-1 damage matrix of GameDesign.md 8, verbatim. One row per weapon class and ten target columns - the six drive classes then the four strength classes, in the order of Content/DamageTable.h - as integer percentages applied to the weapon's damage. armorFactorPercent is how much of the target's armour counts: 100 for the kinetic weapons and flame, 50 for energy, 0 for artillery, which is how artillery is indifferent to armour. armorKind is which armour value it meets. This is the whole of the rock-paper-scissors, and Tools/CheckBalance.py (C3) checks no design dominates its tier.
